# Gate rewards in TEAM races: the chance (%) of each reward when a racer passes a gate, as gate_rewards.txt, for
# team rooms (room type bit 1 or 8, as the 2008 server: BS_Room::Gate 0x5a8ca0) with MORE THAN 4 racers. With up to
# 4 racers a team race uses gate_rewards.txt like any race (the 2008 server did the same: SmallGate).
#
# The values below are the 2008 server's own (s_fTeamReward[clean][reward][32] inside ZoneServer.exe, the position
# scaled onto 32 steps by FixedRank: first = 1, last = 32, else (position - 1) x 32 / (racers - 1)). Unlike the
# normal table it has Team Boost 50% (7). Edit freely: the emulator reads this file when it starts.
#
# The columns are the reward numbers 0-7 sent to the client (0x1ee PvpGateReward):
#   0 nothing          1 Boost 50%        2 Boost 100%       3 Skid Rush
#   4 Repairs Complete 5 Untouchable      6 Hyper Boost      7 Team Boost 50%
# A row should add up to 100; if it adds up to less, the rest of the chance goes to Hyper Boost (6), as the 2008
# server does. A line for a combination that is missing: the nearest lower position / racer count is used.
#
